<!-- pr-reviewer: 631a6d6c20a6c6217a79aaf5b933adbd87b1c252 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks for the careful write-up and the root-cause hunt.

**What looks good**
- Merges cleanly with current `origin/main` (no conflicts). Overlap with the existing axis-fit guards (#208 pole/isotropic no-tilt, #152, #62 uneven-cone refinement, pencil/inlier work) is additive: `worth_refining` only skips refinement when the eigen line is already concurrent to 1e-9 mm per mm of mean radius, and the `pole && iso` guard is kept (`axis.rs:173`). A real lean (microns) is far above that floor and is still refined, which `lathe_spindle_fit` confirms.
- Conservative direction for the Prime Directive: the change makes the fit refine less and the seam law still refuses by name; the seam tolerance widening (1e-6 rad) is far below the whole-degree gaps of a real flat/keyway, and all D-flat refusal tests still refuse. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`, no new casts beyond the existing `round() as i64`.
- Provenance and decision record present (`docs/decisions/228-seam-columns.md`); touched files stay under ~400 lines (axis.rs 396). Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #228`. No build.rs, scripts, workflow or dependency changes; no CHANGELOG.md edit.

**Local results (PR head trial-merged with origin/main, Windows)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run`: builds.
- motion lib 149 pass; `rotary` 10, `rotary_dflat` 7, `rotary_offset` 9, `rotary_links` 7, `rotary_adaptive` 1 (2 ignored), `multiaxis` 7, `cross_invariance` 2, `turning_contour` 13, `turning_stock` 3, `turning_face` 7, `turning_bore` 11, `turning_form` 5, `turning_prof` 8, `turning_blade` 11, `turning_thread` 18: all pass.
- app: `lathe_spindle_fit` 3, `lathe_spindle_keyed` 3, `lathe_spindle_law` 8, `rotary_fixtures` 4, `c_axis_live` 4: all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run by me: motion `finish3d`/`pivot5d`/`flow` and app `center_cut_multiaxis` (slow, and they do not exercise the part-axis fit or the rotary seam), the app UI crate (not touched), Linux/macOS.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `SEAM_TH_TOL` and `CONCURRENT` are absolute-by-construction constants tuned on the issue's fixture (R6, n 16/64). A very large part (rho in the metres) would see 1e-9 relative as a still-tiny residual, which looks fine; just noting both thresholds are only pinned at one size.
- The mixed column-count shaft is still refused (by name) rather than wrapped; that is the right conservative call, as the decision record says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
